globals.name: 003EBO_Atton_Talk
globals.note: dialog 003atton E79 sets 5 after the conversation with slot 6 (003kreia E94 sets 4); a_galaxymap opens the map only above 4, so 5 is the lowest value that lets the story go on. A reply on the ship (003atton E92 > R144, offered while it is below 6) sets 6, and the saves hold 6 (Game2) or 7 (AUTOSAVE, Game3) on Telos. Only the cutscene table (0, 1, 2), a_galaxymap (above 4) and 003atton's own links (below 5, below 6) read it

globals.name: 003EBO_BACKGROUND
globals.note: k_sup_galaxymap sets 1 when Telos (planet 10) is picked on the galaxy map after the escape (it also queues movie TelMov01); a_galaxymap offers no other planet before 262TEL_Escape_Telos (Peragus, row 8, is shown but not selectable), so every run picks Telos. Seen in all three saves past Peragus

globals.name: 003EBO_RETURN_DEST
globals.note: k_sup_galaxymap sets 1 with Telos; check_party_gui (the ship's exit) then sends the party to 201TEL WP_from_ebonhawk. Seen in all three saves past Peragus
